title: Value and Policy Calibration from Execution Feedback for Socially Compatible Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.19969v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous vehicle (AV) decisions at intersections affect the delay, braking, and motion smoothness of surrounding human-driven vehicles (HDVs). Learning socially compatible behavior requires connecting imagined interaction outcomes with feedback from executed actions. We propose a world-model reinforcement learning framework combines imagined policy improvement with direct value and policy calibration from finalized interactions, balancing AV progress with HDV interaction burden. An interaction-aware latent model supports imagination, while off-policy correction and replay updates enable observed rewards and transitions to supervise both the critic and actor. Simulation experiments at an unsignalized intersection achieve a 100% success and reductions in following-HDV acceleration variation of 65.5% and 44.0% relative to PIWM and DreamerV3, respectively. translated_title: 基于执行反馈的价值与策略校准实现社会兼容驾驶
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶汽车（AV）在交叉路口的决策会影响周围人类驾驶车辆（HDV）的延误、制动和运动平稳性。学习社会兼容行为需要将想象中的交互结果与已执行动作的反馈联系起来。我们提出了一种世界模型强化学习框架，将想象中的策略改进与来自已完成交互的直接价值和策略校准相结合，以平衡自动驾驶汽车的通行效率与人类驾驶车辆的交互负担。交互感知的潜在模型支持想象过程，而离策略校正和回放更新使观测到的奖励和状态转移能够同时监督评论家网络和演员网络。在无信号交叉路口的仿真实验中实现了100%的成功率，并且与PIWM和DreamerV3相比，后随人类驾驶车辆的加速度变化分别降低了65.5%和44.0%。消融实验验证了价值校准在减少人类驾驶车辆负担方面的互补作用。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合想象策略改进与执行反馈直接校准的世界模型强化学习框架，使自动驾驶车辆在无信号交叉路口实现100%成功率的同时，显著降低了周围人类驾驶车辆的交互负担（加速度变化最高降低65.5%）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a world-model reinforcement learning framework that combines imagined policy improvement with direct value and policy calibration from execution feedback, enabling autonomous vehicles to achieve 100% success at unsignalized intersections while significantly reducing the interaction burden on surrounding human-driven vehicles (up to 65.5% reduction in acceleration variation).
